name: Nimbus Air 14 Lite
description: Thin 14-inch student laptop with a bright IPS screen
review: Light enough to carry all day and VS Code runs fine, but the screen could be sharper.

name: Nimbus Air 14 Plus
description: Same body as the Lite with double the memory and storage
review: 16 GB RAM makes multitasking smooth; battery lasts a full college day.

name: Vertex Student 15
description: Budget 15-inch laptop with a roomy keyboard
review: Great value and a comfortable keyboard, but it is bulky and the battery is average.

name: Vertex Pro 14
description: Business ultraportable with a metal body
review: Fast, quiet, and the battery easily lasts a work day.

name: Orbit Creator 16
description: Creator laptop with a colour-accurate OLED screen
review: Superb screen and speed for video editing; heavy and the fans get loud.

name: Orbit Go 13
review: Barely notice it in my bag and the battery goes on forever; only 256 GB storage.

name: Lumo Code 14
description: Developer-friendly 14-inch with upgradable RAM and a great keyboard
review: Compiles quickly, keyboard is excellent and the battery lasts two days of classes.

name: Lumo Basic 14
description: Entry-level laptop for browsing and documents
review: Fine for web and documents; slow if you open many tabs.

name: Nimbus Gamer 15
description: Gaming laptop with a 144 Hz display
review: Smooth games, but it is heavy and the battery is short.

name: Vertex Slate 12
review: Incredibly light and long battery; underpowered for heavy coding.

name: Orbit Edu 14
review: Survived being dropped; battery is decent and it is easy to repair.

name: Lumo Studio 15
description: Large-screen laptop for design and analytics
review: Gorgeous large display; sold out most weeks.
